answer: A sponsor locks 200 credits on the oasis ledger; hollow shells stay outside. Each sponsor backs at most three; a bad sponsee decays its reputation 30 points and slashes 50 credits. A raven panel audits each epoch and bars rented sponsors with two bad sponsees. 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors: 200,000 locked, 20,000 fees, 220,000 against at most 40,000 rewards. An honest newcomer pays 20; its sponsor reclaims the stake after a clean epoch.
